company.name: 健立生醫股份有限公司

description.text:
▎Own end-to-end feature delivery across web and mobile: from requirements clarification and design collaboration through implementation, deployment, and monitoring.
▎Build clinician-facing interfaces with a focus on usability under clinical time pressure — physician consultation time is measured in seconds.
▎Build patient-facing portals and health-education content experiences across web and mobile.
▎Develop native iOS and macOS applications, and enhance cross-platform experiences with native components.
▎Build course delivery, assessment, learning-record, and credit-management interfaces for the online education platform.
▎Integrate third-party communication and service APIs, including error handling and retry logic.
▎Integrate LLM-powered features into product surfaces, including streaming responses and graceful degradation when models fail.
▎Collaborate with platform engineers to define API contracts and own end-user-perceived performance.
【BASIC QUALIFICATIONS】
▎3+ years of professional software development experience building and shipping customer-facing applications.
▎Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern frontend framework (React, Vue.js, or Angular), including state management and component architecture.
▎Backend development experience with Node.js, Python, or PHP, including API design and server-side rendering or BFF patterns.
▎Solid full-stack engineering fundamentals: comfortable contributing to backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.
▎Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL) and data modeling for user-facing records.
▎Experience building and debugging integrations against third-party APIs and data systems.
▎Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerized deployment.
▎Proficiency with Git-based workflows and experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment of frontend and backend artifacts.
▎Demonstrated attention to accessibility, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility.
▎Professional reading proficiency in English, sufficient to work directly from framework documentation, API references, and open-source codebases.
▎Native or near-native Traditional Chinese for user-facing copy, UI text, and health-education content.
▎Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
